past_actions.summary: Run standard weekly schedule of driving lessons. Six students booked this week across beginner and intermediate levels. Coordinate vehicle maintenance check on the school's two cars — both due for oil change. Collect tuition from two students whose payment is outstanding.
past_actions.emotional_state: Calm, grounded, mildly vigilant beneath the surface. Frank feels purposeful today — he has students to teach and a schedule to keep. The existential undercurrent ('what am I for?') is present but submerged. He will not acknowledge it unless pressed. His stability is genuine but it rests partly on not looking too hard at certain questions.
